name: Agentic Swe
description:
agentic-swe is a Claude Code plugin that turns a normal repo session into a structured software-engineering pipeline—without a separate runtime.
It ships markdown policies, phase prompts, slash commands, templates, and 135+ specialist subagents. Work is organized with explicit states, human gates (e.g. ambiguity and approval), evidence-friendly artifacts under .worklogs/<id>/, and three pipeline tracks (lean, standard, rigorous) so you can match rigor to risk. Session hooks load policy early; /install helps merge CLAUDE.md into a target project safely.
longDescription:
Ships **3 agents**, **22 commands** and **3 hooks**.

- **Agents** (3): `developer-agent` (Primary implementation specialist for bounded code changes; spawned via the Agent tool), `git-operations-agent` (Repository git specialist for branches, remote sync, and conflict resolution via the Agent tool), `pr-manager-agent` (Pull request workflow specialist for PR creation and lifecycle via the Agent tool)
- **Commands** (22): `author-pipeline` (Extend phases, commands, agents, templates, or references while keeping the pipeline consistent), `brainstorm` (Design-first exploration aligned with the design phase (optional visual companion, design.md)), `check` (Enforce budget, transition, and artifact checks (permission-gated)), `ci-status` (Check CI/CD status for a branch or PR with structured reporting), `conflict-resolver` (Detect, classify, and resolve git merge/rebase conflicts with structured reporting), `diff-review` (Review code changes against structured criteria with evidence-backed findings), `doubt`, `evaluate-work` (Inspect an existing work item and assess its health), and 14 more
- **Hooks** (3): `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `Stop`

Installs with `claude plugin install agentic-swe@claude-community` from `surajSFDC/agentic-swe`.
